new_page.h1: Aberdeen Houses for Sale | Abbotsford Real Estate

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Aberdeen. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Aberdeen, Abbotsford: 23 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 7 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 30%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 5 of 9 Abbotsford communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Abbotsford total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Aberdeen fell from 29 in June to 23 in October (−20.7%), and 20 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 5.6% of Abbotsford’s 410 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Aberdeen?
Aberdeen also had 4 condos and townhomes listed and 3 sold in October, against 23 houses listed. The Aberdeen condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Aberdeen home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

29 houses sold in Aberdeen with a median price of $1,335,000 (the middle half sold between $1,262,500 and $1,482,500), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $388 per square foot, a median year built of 2010 and a median lot of 6,487 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Aberdeen?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 23 houses listed in Aberdeen. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Aberdeen a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Aberdeen had a sales ratio of 30%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Aberdeen from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 20 houses sold in Aberdeen over those 5 months, out of 287 in all of Abbotsford.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Aberdeen?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Aberdeen sell for?
faq.a: 29 houses sold in Aberdeen between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,335,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Aberdeen?
faq.a: The median was 26 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.5% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
